sources.title: Removal of systematics in photometric measurements: static and rotating illumination corrections in FORS2@VLT data
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary paper record and read its abstract: FORS/FORS2 standard-star fields were used to model static and rotating illumination terms; reported flux-scale improvement is about 1–2% for FORS2.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Results and parametrized correction are specific to FORS2, filters, and study data.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports testing residuals against position and orientation; its coefficients and magnitude do not transfer to the teaching camera.

sources.title: Flattening Scientific CCD Imaging Data with a Dome Flat Field System

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The study's dome system, telescope, and illumination arrangement are specific to that experiment.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports star-based known-magnitude/repeatability tests, not its preferred flat technology as a universal answer.

sources.title: Optimized temporal binning of comparison star measurements for differential photometry
sources.locator: Abstract and §1; search result/article page payload
sources.accessed_utc: UNKNOWN; exact successful fetch timestamp was not exposed. Last refresh attempt was 2026-10-10T07:12:15Z and returned a publisher redirect error.
sources.observed_operation: Independently inspected a direct publisher page payload received earlier in this review. It describes comparison-star temporal binning for good photometric conditions and slow common systematics, and says intervals with high-frequency cloud trends may be omitted while binning other intervals.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The method is conditional on high-cadence data and systematics slower than cadence; the paper explicitly allows excluding affected high-frequency-cloud intervals rather than banning the method throughout.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports the critique that the draft's fast-cloud wording is overbroad; does not establish this archive's cadence or benefit.

claim_index.claim: Rotation-dependent flat illumination is a testable precedent, not a transferable local diagnosis.
Calibration/reduction defaults and historical software behavior are version-specific.
The 2023 temporal-binning paper permits exclusion of high-frequency cloud intervals rather than an all-or-nothing ban.
Known-standard/check-star tests support demonstrated performance; no such test was possible here.
TESS is only a conditional independent-data route; cadence, product, and spatial resolution require inspection.
Time scales, correlated noise, and candidate-search significance require explicit controls before period claims.

review_limitations: No scientific data were supplied; case-specific measurements and conclusions remain impossible.

The critic independently reopened consequential primary sources listed here. Sources in the inherited map not listed here were not independently rechecked; their IDs and inherited records remain in the investigator package.
No source finding was treated as evidence that the local telescope used a cited product or implementation.
